name: v0.3.17 — Compact Stash cards · centralized item-card contract · sentence subtitle + on-hand pill
releaseNotes:
• Stash cards now read as a single dense row instead of a stack — title, sentence subtitle (Bought ×N · last date · $total), and a utility row with on-hand pill + rating + value coin + menu. No more empty space.
• Category pill removed from the card; on-hand stock shown there instead (tap → bottom sheet stepper). Re-categorize still available via the actions sheet's new "Change category" button.
• Centralized item-card contract: a JSON spec at test-fixtures/item-card-scenarios.json defines every prop the card accepts plus 20 example scenarios (urgency badges, store pills, ratings, tints, long-text truncation). Mobile FetchCard pumps every scenario in a widget test; web ItemRowCard renders the same spec as an HTML/PDF reference at /item-card-contract.pdf.
• 20-scenario × 2-platform test report (mobile 20/20 pass) — see /item-card-contract.pdf.
